newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - GILTS SET TO SLIDE TO 114-09 AND BELOW.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - GILTS SET TO SLIDE TO 114-09 AND BELOW.

text.p: September gilt futures traded on LIFFE are likely to reverse some of the previous day's upmove, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
On Tuesday, the contract set a high of 114-28, but appears to be forming a topping pattern. Initially it will aim for the previous session's low at 114-09 and then at Monday's low of 114-03.

"If it's a top, it's a rounding top, a bit like a head and shoulders," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "The aggressive downside measure of this is 112-16."
September gilts were down 12/32 at 114-12 by 0815 GMT.

Celaya said support was not very strong below the initial line of defence, largely relying on congestion. He said confirmation of the topping pattern would come if the contract broke below the August 8 low at 113-28.
He said the contract's inability to make progress to the upside had left it stuck in a sideways pattern, and that was likely to put pressure to the downside.
An analyst at a European bank in London said the contract retained upside potential towards 116-00, unless it closed below 114-00.

On the upside, Celaya said Tuesday's 114-28 high was the first target, which added to congestion around 115-00. Above there, 115-08 and 115-19 the August 8 and 7 highs respectively will act as the next resistances.
At the short end, December short sterling futures were down one basis point at 92.64.
